title: Woodcut of a Greenlandic hunting scene, Sketch of the Eskimo
creator: Greenlandic artist (Aron of Kangeq and others)
description: A full-page woodcut opening Rink's sketch of Greenlandic subsistence. Rink's illustrations were drawn by Greenlanders themselves, chiefly the Kangeq hunter and artist Aron, which makes this book one of the earliest published bodies of Inuit-authored pictures.

title: Woman with a child in the amaut (after present fashion), Godthaab
creator: Greenlandic artist
description: A woman carrying a child in the amaut, the pouch of the woman's parka, drawn in the dress worn at Nuuk (Godthaab) in the 1860s.

title: A girl in holiday costume (present fashion), Godthaab
creator: Greenlandic artist
description: A girl in full holiday dress at Nuuk (Godthaab): the beaded collar, the short trousers and the high patterned kamiit.

title: The kayak, the large harpoon with its thrower, and the kayak paddle
creator: Greenlandic artist
description: A plate combining the throwing board, the large harpoon with the thrower attached, the kayak paddle, and below them kayakers at sea in half-jackets of skin. The hunting equipment on which the whole Greenlandic economy rested, drawn to scale with its parts named.

title: The large lance or spear
creator: Greenlandic artist
description: The lance used to kill a harpooned seal or walrus, drawn whole with details of its head and foreshaft.

title: Woodcut illustrating a tale: the meeting on the ice
creator: Greenlandic artist (Aron of Kangeq and others)
description: A crowded woodcut of figures gathered on the ice, illustrating one of the traditional tales in Rink's collection. Aron of Kangeq drew the scenes of the tales from the inside, as a Greenlander who had grown up with them.

title: Woodcut illustrating a tale: figures on the hillside
creator: Greenlandic artist (Aron of Kangeq and others)
description: A woodcut of figures spread across a hill slope, illustrating one of the tales of the later section, which turn on encounters with Europeans and with the Danish colony.

title: Woodcut illustrating a tale: a scattered crowd
creator: Greenlandic artist (Aron of Kangeq and others)
description: A woodcut with many small figures dispersed across the sheet, illustrating a tale in Rink's collection.

title: Woodcut illustrating a tale: the assembly in the house
creator: Greenlandic artist (Aron of Kangeq and others)
description: A woodcut of a row of hooded figures ranged inside a dwelling, illustrating one of the tales towards the end of the collection.
